applicabilityBasis.summary: suiUSDe is marketed for Sui collateral, margin and settlement and aims at one U.S. dollar. suiUSDe Ltd terms and Mint User Agreement provide approved-user redemption in USDC or other supported digital assets, with pro-rata reserves and no guaranteed notional rate or availability. Public evidence does not establish an obligation to repay a fixed amount of monetary value as GENIUS section 2(22) requires. The synthetic/USDe reserve backing and U.S.-person restrictions alone do not prove statutory exclusion.

genius.notes: Canonical suiUSDe is not an appreciating vault receipt and is issued by separately named suiUSDe Ltd; no Ethena GmbH/BVI authorization or BaFin restriction is transferred. Terms specify BVI governing law/arbitration but do not by themselves prove corporate domicile, so issuerDomicile is not assigned. They include the United States among Restricted Territories for general eligibility and separately exclude U.S. Mint Users; those contractual controls are not a GENIUS exemption. Qualitative reserve composition is publicly disclosed in issuer terms; the whitelabel dashboard static shell showed placeholders, not a verified monthly financial attestation. No exact PPSI approval, state qualification, official application or registered foreign exception was located in checked public sources. Rules are pre-effective with Treasury expecting January 18, 2027; the separate general DASP deadline is July 18, 2028.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official PPSI application or registered foreign exception naming suiUSDe Ltd / suiUSDe / eSui Dollar was located in the listed sources. This is a dated public-evidence finding, not proof that no private or unindexed application exists. Bank-charter and legacy licensing tables are not comprehensive GENIUS registers; proposed rules and SCRC procedural forms do not authorize an issuer.
